went to Auchinleck Surgery at 8 a.m. to drop off a sample, as the surgery is advertised online as being open from 8:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. It was -6°C outside, yet the door was locked. I called the surgery and was told by a staff member that they don’t open the door until 8:30 a.m.

I asked if there was a drop-off bin or a safe place to leave the sample, and the answer was no. I then asked if someone could collect it since I was already outside, and the response was also no.

This surgery claims to serve the local community, but there is nothing “community” about their approach. Their lack of flexibility and unwillingness to help is beyond frustrating—about as useful as a chocolate teapot - and that is putting it politely.

I can now see why so many people in the local area have rated this surgery 1 star. The fact that they continue to operate without addressing the concerns raised in these reviews is disgraceful.",null,[0,236]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmaTUtU3Z3RRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xfa4ba74f5062d95f!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgIDfi5-SvwE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmaTUtU3Z3RRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmaTUtU3Z3RRItChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURmaTUtU2Z3EhNDZ3dJcjdPRHZBWVF5SV9hcXdJGi4KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJRGZpNS1TX3dFEhNDZ3dJcjdPRHZBWVF5SV9hcXdJIhIJAAAAAAAAAAARX9liUE-nS_oqE0Nnd0lyN09EdkFZUXlJX2Fxd0k&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjr5ZyP07OTAxUCHmMBHRrPNMcQoykIEygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjr5ZyP07OTAxUCHmMBHRrPNMcQ0pMFCBEoBQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSM1YzY21GdWVsOWZSV2hDZEhNemVXSnpUelpaZEdabGNFa3dRVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEp2YzBOaE4wTjBjV1pOV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURQZ3NmOUJnEAE",["0x0:0xfa4ba74f5062d95f",null,1732957846132139,1732957846132139,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/109319833090403372136/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Geraldine
